# beave-rs

> A lightweight Rust message processing framework built around typed handlers.

Every page is available as Markdown at the page URL with `.html` replaced by `.md`.
All pages in one file: https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/llms-full.txt

## Overview

- [README](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/index.md): Project overview, installation, quick start, and Cargo features
- [Guides](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/index.md): Index of the guides

## Using beave-rs

- [Architecture](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/architecture.md): How sources, handlers, and sinks fit together, their trait contracts, and errors
- [Runtime guide](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/runtime.md): Registration, configuration, processing behavior, shutdown, and limitations, with topic guides for handlers, middleware, errors, tombstones, transactions, observability, and health checks
- [Handlers](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/runtime/handlers.md)
- [Middleware](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/runtime/middleware.md)
- [Errors and retries](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/runtime/errors.md)
- [Tombstones](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/runtime/tombstones.md)
- [Transactions](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/runtime/transactions.md)
- [Observability](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/runtime/observability.md)
- [Health checks](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/runtime/health.md)
- [Adapters](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters.md): Local, channel, Kafka, Pulsar, RabbitMQ, SQS, Pub/Sub, Azure Service Bus, and HTTP adapters, usage, and extension contracts
- [Local adapters](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/local.md)
- [Channel adapter](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/channel.md)
- [Kafka adapter](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/kafka.md)
- [Pulsar adapter](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/pulsar.md)
- [RabbitMQ adapter](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/rabbitmq.md)
- [SQS adapter](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/sqs.md)
- [Pub/Sub adapter](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/pubsub.md)
- [Azure Service Bus adapter](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/servicebus.md)
- [HTTP adapter](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/adapters/http.md)
- [Codecs](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs.md): Serialization contracts; JSON, raw bytes, UTF-8, Protobuf, Avro, MessagePack, and CBOR codecs; Base64 and compression wrappers
- [JSON codec](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/json.md)
- [Raw bytes codec](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/raw-bytes.md)
- [UTF-8 codec](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/utf8.md)
- [Protobuf codec](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/protobuf.md)
- [Avro codec](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/avro.md)
- [MessagePack codec](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/msgpack.md)
- [CBOR codec](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/cbor.md)
- [Codec wrappers](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/wrappers.md)
- [Base64 wrapper](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/wrappers/base64.md)
- [Gzip wrapper](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/wrappers/gzip.md)
- [Zstd wrapper](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/codecs/wrappers/zstd.md)
- [Testing](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/testing.md): Testing handlers, middleware, and error policies with fabricated broker records
- [Handling dead letters](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/dead-letter-handling.md): Finding the cause of dead letters, and reprocessing, parking, or dropping them on log and queue brokers
- [Monitoring and alerting](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/monitoring-and-alerting/index.md): Signals to alert on, alert rules, and setups for Kubernetes, AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure
- [Kubernetes](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/monitoring-and-alerting/kubernetes.md)
- [AWS](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/monitoring-and-alerting/aws.md)
- [Google Cloud](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/monitoring-and-alerting/gcp.md)
- [Azure](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/monitoring-and-alerting/azure.md)

## Contributing

- [Local development brokers](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/development.md): Docker Compose Kafka, Pulsar, RabbitMQ, ElasticMQ, Pub/Sub emulator, and Service Bus emulator brokers, web consoles, broker examples, and live tests
- [beave-rs — Design plan](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/plan.md): Product goals, agreed design direction, future work, and open questions
- [Versioning and releases](https://cafeal.github.io/beave-rs/pr-preview/pr-55/docs/releasing.md): Version numbers, the compatibility contract, the minimum supported Rust version, and the website
